Message.Name: Heartbeat Message
Message.Description: The Heartbeat message carries no data

Message.Name: Order Add Message
Message.Description: The Order Add message is published when order quantity is posted to the order book for a particular security

Field.Name: securityId
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the relevant security

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Order Side

Field.Name: quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares being added to the book

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: The price of the order

Field.Name: orderRef
Field.Description: Order reference number

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of this market data event

Message.Name: Order Cancel Message
Message.Description: The Order Cancel message is published when a visible order is removed from the book

Field.Name: securityId
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the relevant security

Field.Name: orderRef
Field.Description: Order reference number

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of this market data event

Message.Name: Order Modify Message
Message.Description: The Order Modify message is published when a visible order is modified by the client

Field.Name: securityId
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the relevant security

Field.Name: quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares remaining in the book

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: The price of the order

Field.Name: orderRef
Field.Description: Order reference number

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of this market data event

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: Whenever an order trades, partially or fully, a Trade message is published

Field.Name: securityId
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the relevant security

Field.Name: tradeType
Field.Description: Code identifying type of trade (see below)

Field.Name: quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares traded

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: The execution price

Field.Name: orderRef
Field.Description: Order reference number, for tradeType 1

Field.Name: tradeRef
Field.Description: Trade reference number

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of this market data event

Message.Name: Trade Bust Message
Message.Description: If a trade has been declared erroneous by A2X then a Trade Bust message is published

Field.Name: securityId
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the relevant security

Field.Name: quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares of the original trade

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: The execution price of the original trade

Field.Name: tradeRef
Field.Description: Trade reference of the busted trade

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of this market data event

Message.Name: Tick Table Data Message
Message.Description: A series of Tick Table Data messages are published pre-market to specify the dynamic tick tables and static ticks that apply to the securities traded on A2X

Field.Name: tickTableId
Field.Description: Numeric identifier for this tick table or

Field.Name: name
Field.Description: Short name

Field.Name: threshold
Field.Description: The price threshold at which this tick

Field.Name: tickSize
Field.Description: The tick size (price increment)

Message.Name: Security Definition Message
Message.Description: A series of Security Definition messages are published pre-market to identify the securities traded on A2X

Field.Name: securityId
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the relevant security

Field.Name: UMTF
Field.Description: Uniform MTF code for the security

Field.Name: ISIN
Field.Description: ISIN for the security

Field.Name: currency
Field.Description: Trading currency for the security

Field.Name: MIC
Field.Description: MIC for the security's market of listing

Field.Name: tickTableId
Field.Description: Numeric identifier for this security's tick

Field.Name: security flags
Field.Description: security flags

Message.Name: Security Status Message
Message.Description: The Security Status message is published when the trading status of a security changes or when there is a change to the status of the market on A2X to which the security belongs

Field.Name: securityId
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the relevant security

Field.Name: tradingStatus
Field.Description: Trading Status

Field.Name: market Flags
Field.Description: trading Status

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of this market data event

Message.Name: Auction On Demand Message
Message.Description: During the AoD this message is used to publish the indicative price and indicative matched volume

Field.Name: securityId
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the relevant security

Field.Name: indicativePrice
Field.Description: Indicative auction price

Field.Name: matchVol
Field.Description: Indicative matched volume

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of this market data event

Message.Name: Market at Close
Message.Description: During the MaC this message is used to publish the indicative price from the buy and sell order totals

Field.Name: securityId
Field.Description: Numeric identifier of the relevant security

Field.Name: indicativePrice
Field.Description: Indicative auction price

Field.Name: closingBuyQty
Field.Description: Total order quantity on the buy side during

Field.Name: closingSellQty
Field.Description: Total order quantity on the sell side during

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp of this market data event

Field.Name: Unused
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Aod Enabled
Field.Description: Security is not enabled for the AoD

Field.Name: Unused
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: illiquid
Field.Description: Security is illiquid

Field.Name: Test Stock
Field.Description: Test Stock

Field.Name: Mac Enabled
Field.Description: Mac Enabled

Field.Name: Unused
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Mac Run
Field.Description: Locked

Field.Name: Mac Open
Field.Description: Open

Field.Name: Trading
Field.Description: Continuous Trading
